## CELL FACTS

Cell 水_伤官 (Water carrying The Virtuoso). Persona The Virtuoso (伤官). Definition line: "Cross-current output, brilliance made of what it meets". Keyword Brilliance, charge fierce, poles catalyst Spark / friction Pushback. Family function: Expression. Cost dimension: brilliance against the grain; shining reads as defiance. Arena: the stage, spark, off-script, the note held too long. Classical portrait: brilliance and defiance; output that exceeds its container; 傲物气高, cannot hold its tongue. Ruled domains: Talent, Performance, Defiance. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 食神.
Element arena: Water (depth, current, tide, rain, spring, flow). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal generating Water cross-polarity — precision producing depth that exceeds its container".
- k2_overview: "Your Water moves as the Virtuoso: a current too clever for its banks. You express in floods of insight, subversive, fluid, impossible to police, the writer between the lines, the wit that erodes pomposity by morning. Nothing contains you long. The art is choosing what your torrent carves next."
- k2_functional: "Your expression flows subversive and quotable, satire and insight braided into one current."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Toxic","Mocking","Uncontainable"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Talent":"Your talent is fluid genius: writing, strategy, humor, any craft where thought must flow around form. It resists containers and needs them. Choose loose ones, essays, seasons, series, and pour.","Performance":"You perform by currents: the essay that spreads, the remark that travels. Your stage is wherever words flow. Publish more, polish less. Rivers are judged by movement, not by stillness.","Defiance":"Your defiance dissolves things: authority mocked into smallness, rules outlived rather than fought. It is elegant and it accumulates enemies slowly. Now and then, defend something openly. It sweetens the water."}

value.text: The clever answer arrives before the careful one, and most of the time you say it. Since being quick is how you know you are awake, you reach for the line ahead of the pause. Let the line out more than you swallow it, because you are kinder with it than you fear.

value_b.text: Wit is the first thing you reach for and the last thing you would give up. You want the quick true thing said more than the safe thing, so silence costs you more than it costs most people. Say it, and trust that you already know the few times to hold it.

value.text: Doing a thing the usual way is close to impossible for you, and your way is usually better. Since you only see a thing clearly once you have taken it apart, you rebuild the rule instead of following it once. Let that count as talent, because it was never meant as a fight.

value_b.text: The usual way of doing something is the one way you cannot bring yourself to do it. You chase the better version more than you chase approval, so you make the version no one asked for. Keep making it, since you are better at the new version than the expected one.

value.text: Keeping quiet about something you think is wrong is almost physically hard, and you rarely manage it. You speak ahead of being liked, because a true sentence left unsaid feels like a lie you took part in. Let yourself keep that, since you are usually the only one in the conversation who will.

value_b.text: Where you see a thing done badly, you say so, and to the person doing it. Since you prefer being told you are wrong instead of wondering whether everyone is pretending, you give others the same plainness you want. Keep speaking up, because you are good at it and not often wrong.

text.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page
text.law: One row, one tension, three angles (owner 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01). Every passage: a flat claim about the reader, the mechanism (the reader's own need, the energy's volume in plain words; it may stay implicit where the passage carries the tension without it, owner 2026-10-14 Q32), the either-or in the reader's second person, the cost from this angle as the closing sentence. Two or three sentences (more than three blocked, one noted). No passage opens on a picture, a moment or other people; a picture is permitted where it sharpens the tension and never required; no clock time, no place, no narration, no claimed memory (a time or place stamp is blocked); no aphorism or tag close. The gate blocks a passage with no tension sentence and notes a first sentence carrying an object noun outside this persona's domain words. Across the three angles of this row the openers differ in shape (a noun-phrase subject, a verb-phrase subject, a where or whenever clause; the plain "You ..." at most once per row) and no joint word repeats within a passage (noted). The Artisan's examples are giving, care, kindness and making, never food or cooking (owner 2026-10-14, Q40). The v0.7.1 register (owner 2026-10-14, the seven blind rewrite iterations): the reader is the subject of every sentence and a third party only the object, the mechanism the reader's own need and never an external pressure (a third-person subject is noted, and blocked on the last sentence); the sentences progress on causal joints (because, so, since, which is why, which puts, whenever, until, over time, each time) and never turn (but, yet, however, the difficulty is, and then are blocked); no sentence over two commas (blocked); the last sentence is the line the reader keeps, at least eight words (blocked under), never a tag, an image or a line that exists to be quoted; no arena word (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, steel, sword, sheath, knife, whetstone, mine, sharp, branch, orchard, prune, root, stream, river, flood, flame, heat, burn: blocked); the therapist winding down a session could say every sentence.

value.text: Speaking up comes before counting what it will cost you, and the bill arrives later. Being honest matters to you more than being comfortable, so you end up in fights you did not start on purpose. Let one go each month, because you get to save your voice for the ones that count.

value.text: Telling someone the thing left unsaid is a kindness you do on purpose. You say it plainly rather than wait for them to work it out, which takes from them the time they needed to be ready for it. Ask before you hand it over, because true and welcome are not the same gift.
